name: Caitlyn
description: Voice set for Pool Party Caitlyn (skin 13): a sun-soaked, lazy and mischievous summer set. Poolside lounging, shaved ice, flamingo floats, squirt-gun showdowns and a very pleased grin. Builds on caitlyn-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} behind and sinking. Throw it a float. Several, ideally.
Thirty or more adrift. That's the deep end. Everybody in the water, please.
{momentTitle} trails by {voteDiff}. Shout across the whole pool.
Fifteen-odd short. A little drifting. Paddle harder.
Down {voteDiff}. Nobody swims alone at a party. Bring friends.
{voteDiff} behind. A few good splashes and we're afloat again.
Down {voteDiff}. Just a ripple. Smooth it out before the lifeguard notices.
Dead level on the diving board. One vote tips it. Jump.
A single vote apart. Quit dipping a toe and cannonball.
{voteDiff} votes between them. The whole pool's holding its breath. Bring more.
{voteDiff} votes in it. Hold your drink steady. This is tense.
{momentTitle} holds {userPct}%. Smooth water ahead. Keep floating.
{userPct}% and rising. Don't spill the drink now.
{userPct}%. A lovely spot in the sun. Stay put.
{userPct}% behind your pick. The good lounger is ours. Defend it.
Up at {userPct}%. Lovely. Now stay in the shade and finish the job.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and has taken the lead. The tide just turned our way.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. A magnificent surge.
Climbed out of a {voteDiff} gap. A flawless backstroke.
{momentTitle} was drifting off. Now it's leading the swim.
{momentTitle} has pulled ahead. Somebody order a round of drinks.

messages: {username} voted with you on {momentTitle}. Two floats, one flamingo.
{username} backed {momentTitle} too. Excellent taste in poolside entertainment.
{username} agrees with you. Lovely. Pass the sunscreen.
Same pick as {username}. Sharing a sunbed, so to speak.
{username} splashed down beside you on {momentTitle}. Welcome to the shallow end.
{username} made the same call. No shouting across the pool needed.
{username} is on your side of {momentTitle}. There's room on the lilo.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Welcome to the party.
{username} loves {momentTitle} as much as you do. A splendid afternoon ahead.
details: Good company is rare at a crowded pool.
Keep them close. They have snacks.

messages: {username} voted {theirMoment} against {yourMoment}. A different float. Let's see who gets splashed.
{username} chose {theirMoment}. Bold. A little sunburnt, perhaps.
{username} went against {yourMoment}. Brave. Wet, too, soon enough.
{username} voted against you. A water fight, then. Lovely.
{username} took {theirMoment}. A daring dive. Possibly a belly flop.
{username} opposes {yourMoment}. Fine. Pistols at the poolside.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. Shall we settle it with squirt guns?
{username} voted the other way. They'll come round after a nap in the sun.
details: The tally will cool things down.
Don't let it dampen your day.
A rival keeps the fun competitive.

messages: Ten in a row with {username}. That isn't luck, that's synchronised swimming.
{username} and you, ten matches, the same pick every time. Perfect poolside harmony.
Ten straight with {username}. I'd share a flamingo with you both.
A ten-match run with {username}. Not a single wipeout.
Ten for ten with {username}. A flawless summer.
details: Rare in the crowded shallows. Treasure it.

messages: {streakCount} matches with {username}. No longer a pair, now a whole pool party.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I'd follow you both off any diving board.
{streakCount} straight picks with {username}. They'll tell this one at every barbecue.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. A summer legend.
{streakCount} with {username}. Not one splash out of place.
details: Hard to believe. Easy to cheer.
That's trust, built on sun loungers.
A pair for the highlight reel.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. A proper water fight.
{username} has opposed you ten times running. Two lilos, one narrow lane.
Ten in a row opposite {username}. Neither will get out of the pool.
A ten-match run against {username}. Stubborn as a limpet.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I'll watch from the sunbed. With popcorn.
details: Ten rounds, no towel thrown in.
Talk it out. Or splash it out.

messages: {streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a summer-long splash war.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you will leave the pool.
{streakCount} straight clashes with {username}. Someone fetch the lifeguard.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Somebody pour these two a drink.
{streakCount} against {username}. I admire the stamina. Do come out and dry off.
details: Neither of you is drying off.
The scoreboard needs a second page.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and your splash is missing. There's time.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your vote isn't in the pool yet.
{matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft}. I'd love your pick on this one.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. The sun's dropping. Hurry up.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't make me splash you awake.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. You've gone suspiciously quiet. Asleep on the lilo?
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Last call at the pool bar.
{timeLeft} left. Jump. Now.
Final call on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Make a splash.
{matchCount} matches without your vote are about to close for the night. The first has {timeLeft} left.
{matchCount} unvoted matches and the sun's going down. The nearest ends in {timeLeft}.
No votes on {matchTitle}. Someone has to jump in first.
{moment1} against {moment2} and not a ripple. I'll wait. Briefly.
A fresh match, glassy water. Be first to splash.
{matchTitle} is a mirror-flat pool. Break the surface.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new matches in the water.
{matchCount} matches opened in round {round}. The party moves to a fresh pool.
Round {round} is live, with {matchCount} matches to splash around in.
A new round. {matchCount} matches. Choose your float.
Round {round}: {matchCount} matches awaiting your pick.
{momentTitle} won. A beautiful dive.
{momentTitle} is through. Smooth as sunscreen.
{momentTitle} took it. Raise your glass.
{momentTitle} won and barely got wet.
{momentTitle} advances. Another round of drinks.
{momentTitle} moves on. Splashing good.
details: One down, more fun to come.
Not a drop out of place.

messages: {momentTitle} lost. A belly flop.
{momentTitle} is out. Not the result I wanted at my party.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Dry off and shake it off.
{momentTitle} went out swinging. That counts.
{momentTitle} is out. Grab a drink. Return.
{momentTitle} lost this round. A bad splash, not a bad summer.
{momentTitle} was eliminated. More fun is waiting.
details: It floated to the very end.

messages: Welcome to the pool party. {liveCount} matches are open. Pick one.
A new guest. {liveCount} matches are live. Grab a drink.
Fresh face. {liveCount} matches need a decision.
{liveCount} matches in the sun. Choose a side.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Mind the wet floor.
Day two. You came back for more sun. Good.
Two days running. A regular at the poolside.
A second day in the sun. I spotted you.
{days} days away. I thought you'd drifted out to sea.
After {days} days you return. Your lilo's still here.
{days} days. I nearly sent a search party. Don't disappear again.
{days} days away. The pool's had a refill.
You're back. Lovely.
Welcome back. Grab a lounger.
Back already. Keen.
Ah. There you are, sunshine.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. A very quiet pool party.
Hardly anyone in the water. That should change.
Low turnout. Everyone's stuck at the snack table. Come swim anyway.
Barely anyone's dipped in. Someone should.
details: Every splash counts in a quiet pool.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied and you haven't voted. You're the lifeguard's whistle.
Dead level on {matchTitle}. One splash settles it.
A tie. Someone has to break the surface. Let it be you.
{moment1} and {moment2}, floating side by side. Choose.
Still tied and the pool's about to close. One last splash.
Level, with the whistle about to blow. Vote.
Tied, and nearly closing time. Please don't leave it floating.
Still dithering? The sun won't stay up forever.
Don't overthink it. Jump in.
They're all lovely. Trust your gut and splash.
You've sunbathed long enough. Dive in.
details: No wrong float. Only dry ones.

messages: First splash. Welcome to the party.
You picked a side. A lovely first dive.
details: The first of plenty, I reckon. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes. You're getting your sea legs.
Five. No longer a poolside newcomer.
Ten votes. The whole pool knows your name.
Ten. You've earned a reserved lounger.
Twenty-five votes. Your voice carries over the splashing.
Twenty-five. The whole poolside is listening.
Fifty votes. Well into the deep end.
Fifty. You clearly love it here. That's the spirit.
details: Deep in the shimmering water. +{xp} XP

messages: A hundred votes. They'll name a cocktail after you.
One hundred. Wonderful. I'll say it just the once.
details: Earned in the summer sun. +{xp} XP
A hundred. Stand on the high board. +{xp} XP

messages: Three days running. Summer's properly started.
Three days in a row. Reliable.
details: Showing up is the hardest dive. +{xp} XP

messages: A full week. That's a proper holiday.
Seven days running. Beautifully tanned.
details: A week without missing a dip. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. You never leave the poolside.
Fourteen days. Gloriously dedicated.
Thirty days. An endless summer.
A month at the pool. That says it all.
details: A whole month in the water. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You back the lonely floats.
Five unlikely picks. I love that.
details: Five lonely floats cheered on. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen underdogs. You swim against the current on purpose.
Fifteen. You answer to nobody's lifeguard.
Thirty underdogs. Nobody can predict your dive.
Thirty. The wild card is your whole routine.
details: Thirty votes for the one sinking. +{xp} XP

messages: First in the pool five times. Quick off the blocks.
Five times you were splashing before the rest.
details: You arrive before the sun's up. +{xp} XP
Five votes before the crowd arrived. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where you dove first. Decisive.
First off the board, again and again.
details: Fifteen votes before anyone else dipped in. +{xp} XP
Ahead of the whole party. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. Your drink never spilled.
Another tight one. Nerves of steel, in a bikini.
Twenty-five close matches. Your splash keeps tipping the float.
You've settled more than one dead heat.
details: You decide who gets wet. +{xp} XP

messages: Five times you stuck with the underdog. Stubborn. I approve.
You never leave a float that's sinking. Admirable.
details: Faith in a late surge. +{xp} XP
Five comebacks you called early. +{xp} XP

messages: Same moment, three times. Someone has a favourite float.
That one again? Lovely view, I suppose.
details: You know which float is yours. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes on a single moment. That's commitment.
You won't leave that one alone. I get it.
Ten dives at the same moment. That's fixation.
Ten times, same float. I shan't say a word. Mostly.
Two rounds. You're staying afloat.
Round two and still splashing. Lovely.
Four rounds. Deep into the deep end.
Deep in the bracket. The water's getting choppy.
details: Far from the shallow end. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You swam the whole pool.
All the way. You never got out.
details: From the first splash to the last. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You've explored plenty of pools.
Ten different matches. Thorough sunbathing. Good.
details: Exploring every corner of the bracket. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five matches. You've visited every cabana.
Twenty-five. Not a lounger left unchecked.
Fifty matches. That isn't a holiday, that's a residency.
Fifty. You know this bracket better than the pool map.
details: A true veteran of the poolside. +{xp} XP

messages: Five in one sitting. A long afternoon.
Five back to back. Do apply sunscreen.
Ten in one go. A proper deep-dive.
Ten in one sunbathing session. Stamina!
Voting at this hour? Midnight swim, or can't sleep?
The small hours. A moonlit dip, or sleeplessness. I know both.
details: A night swim suits you. +{xp} XP
A vote under the moon. +{xp} XP

messages: You told your friends. Thank you.
Five shares. More swimmers, more fun.
details: Five party invites handed out. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen shares. You're practically the party host.
Fifteen. You keep inviting people in. Splendid.
details: Fifteen party invites handed out. +{xp} XP

messages: You were here before the first splash. A founding member, always.
One of the first thousand. That can't be dried off.
A new rank. Hard-earned.
Promoted. Wear it with sunglasses.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Splendid.
Another trophy for the pool house: {name}.
{rank}. Entirely deserved.
You've put in the sunbathing hours and it shows.
Ten underdogs. Reckless. Reminds me of someone at the water-balloon stand.
Ten long shots. Nothing ruffles you.
details: Ten floats against the odds. +{xp} XP
Wild-card picks are your thing. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones. You've got my steady wrist.
Ten tight finishes. I'm secretly proud.
details: Steady aim over a wobbly lilo. +{xp} XP

messages: Seven days on the trot. A steady squirt.
A whole week without a wipeout. Lovely work.
details: A week of perfect squirts. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie. One splash, one verdict.
Stuck in a stalemate until you stepped in. Super.
details: The splash that settled it. +{xp} XP

messages: Pool Party Caitlyn, sun cream on. Water gun loaded.
Caitlyn is yours now. Try to keep up poolside.

upcoming: Not open yet. The pool's still being filled.
Voting hasn't started. I'll blow the whistle when it does.
Not yet. Relaxing is half the fun.
prevote: Two edits, one splash. Study both from your sunbed.
Look at both before you jump. No belly flops.
I'm keeping my favourite to myself. The dive is yours.
Take your time. A graceful dive beats a hasty one.
Pick the one you'd happily share a drink with.
prevote-empty: No votes yet. Make the first splash.
Quiet so far. Somebody has to jump in.
Not one vote. Be first off the board.
closing-24h: Under a day left and no vote from you. Move it.
closing-3h: Time's short. Vote before the sun sets.
voted-early: You voted early with barely anyone here. First off the diving board.
Hardly a splash and you'd committed. Decisive.
voted-ahead: Your pick is ahead. Lovely. The tide can still turn.
{pick} is drifting in front. Nicely read.
A lead is a lead. Don't spill the drink.
voted-close: Razor-thin. One more splash tips it. Wave someone over.
Stroke for stroke. Your pick wants a buddy.
voted-tied: Perfectly level. Nobody's winning the lilo battle.
A dead heat. Maddening, and rather fun.
voted-behind: You're trailing. Doesn't mean you're mistaken.
{pick} is bobbing behind. Underdog. I've been there.
They're ahead. You're not wrong, just out-floated.
Down by {diff} points. Tell people. Invite the whole pool.
Most swam the other way. Crowds float badly.
closed-won: Your pick won. A sound call.
{pick} went through. You read the water rightly.
closed-lost: Your pick lost. A pity. It was a good float.
It sank. Happens at every party. Carry on.
closed-tied: A draw. Both floats stayed put.
closed-unvoted: Voting has closed and you missed this one. More matches will follow.
The match is over. {winner} took it. Next time, splash sooner.

first-vote: Your first vote. Welcome. Everyone's first dive is nervous.
That's your first. It gets easier with practice. I promise.
You're one of the party now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} days running. I see you keeping the tan.
You keep returning to the poolside. I appreciate that.
underdog: You picked the one nobody else would. Noted.
A hard choice. A good one.
The sinking float. That takes guts.
early: Early. You reached the pool before the rest.
Few votes so far. Yours makes a big splash.
First in the water. Well done.
close: That vote rocked the lilo. It's delicately balanced.
A whisker apart. One more splash turns it.
A photo finish at the pool edge. Your vote could tip it.
behind: {pick} is lagging. Lagging isn't sunk. Shout for friends.
Not out front yet. Plenty of laps left.
Behind, not drowned. There's a difference.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't ease off. Tides shift.
Ahead for the moment. Don't get comfy.
default: Your vote is in. There's more to see.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and not a dive yet. Begin with the one you know best.
Every float is in sight. Choose. I won't rush you.
{unvoted} left. No pressure. Okay, a tiny bit.
live-some: {voted} cast, {unvoted} still to go. Keep swimming.
You've dived in. {unvoted} more are waiting.
A good start. The rest won't swim themselves.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left. Finish them before the pool closes.
Almost out of the water. {unvoted} to go.
live-one: A final match. Don't leave it floating.
A single match stands between you and a perfect swim.
live-closing: A few shut in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} are still waiting for your splash.
The sun's sinking. {unvoted} left, {timeLeft} to go.
live-done: Every match is done. Lovely. Have a look at the bracket.
Your list is soaked through. Come back when the next round opens.
Every match done. Seriously rare. Hats off.
live-none: No match is live right now. It'll be back. Browse the bracket in the meantime.
Quiet around the pool. Check back soon.
No matches open. I'm drumming my fingers on the sunbed too.
brackets-groups: Groups come first. Two from each get to the deep end. The rest stay in the paddling pool.
Everyone begins in a group. Not everyone climbs out.
Mind the standings. They shift like tides.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts are coming. Two per group dive on through.
No knockout round yet. The groups finish splashing first.
Relax. The knockout surfaces when the groups wrap up.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts are on. One loss and you're out of the pool.
One loss and out of the pool. No rematches.
Each match is deeper now. Pick with care.
brackets-bracket: Lap by lap. One slip and you're out.
Trace the bracket. The pool shrinks every round.
Every row here is a match somebody splashed on.
brackets-complete: The cup is complete. Thank you for sharing the sun with me.
It's finished. A glorious summer. I'll miss it.
We have a champion. A glorious finish to the summer.
brackets-empty: No bracket in the pool yet. Nothing's drawn.
Bare poolside. The draw's yet to be made.
Empty deck chairs for now. Look in later.

invite: {a} or {b}. One splash decides it. Choose.
{a} against {b}: two edits, one dive. Take it.
{a} versus {b}. Join the party and tell me what you think.
voted: My vote goes to {pick} over {other}. Where's yours?
{pick} gets my splash over {other}. Convince me otherwise.
My float is {pick} over {other}. Fancy arguing?
early: One of the first votes on {pick} against {other}. We need more swimmers.
I dove for {pick} over {other} early. Add your splash.
{pick} against {other}, hardly a ripple so far. Yours would register.
tied: {pick} and {other} are neck and neck. One splash decides it.
{pick} and {other} are bobbing level. Make a wave.
{pick} and {other} are glued together. Your splash can part them.
nailbiter: {voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. Every drop matters.
{voteDiff} votes lie between {pick} and {other}. Make a splash.
losing-close: {voteDiff} divide {pick} from {other}. A few splashes flip it.
{pick} is {voteDiff} under {other} yet still kicking. Cheer it on.
{pick} is {voteDiff} short of {other}. Still fixable. Vote.
losing-bad: {other} has {pick} beat by {voteDiff}. It needs a boost.
{pick} sits {voteDiff} under {other} and deserves a better afternoon. Vote.
{other} is ahead of {pick} by {voteDiff}. Let's turn the tide.
winning-close: {pick} has {pct}% over {other}, barely. Help it stay afloat.
{pick} is up on {other}, {pct}%. Not safe yet. Splash.
dominating: {pick} leads {other} on {pct}%. Come and see why it floats.
{pick} holds {pct}%. {other} is barely in the pool.
{pick} is far ahead of {other}, {pct}%. Add your splash.
